name: Speaking of Fortitude
summary: Brother Kristoff has sent Head Librarian Milton Sheaf searching the Royal Library for an exact volume.

sections.title: A Metaphor in Metal
sections.body: Brother Kristoff is preparing a sermon on the Fortitude of the Spirit. To give his congregation a clear picture of spiritual strength, he turns to metalworking alongside scripture. He hopes a treatise on iron enduring pressure will serve as his example.

sections.title: The Royal Stacks
sections.body: Head Librarian Milton Sheaf knows the Royal Library's archive by heart. Still, he must check whether it holds the exact title Kristoff seeks. Its centuries of histories, civic writings, and craft works give him plenty to search.

faq.answer: Brother Kristoff is a priest serving the Church of the Holy Light in Cathedral Square, Stormwind City. He often asks visitors to find materials and references for his teachings and sermons.

faq.q: What book is Brother Kristoff looking for?
faq.answer: Brother Kristoff seeks "The Stresses of Iron," a technical text on metalworking. He plans to cite it as a metaphor for spiritual endurance.
Milton Sheaf is head librarian of the Royal Library inside Stormwind Keep. He oversees the kingdom's books, scrolls, and civic records, and knows the collection well.

faq.q: Where is the Royal Library located?
faq.answer: The Royal Library lies in the northeastern wing of Stormwind Keep. Reach it through the royal palace's main hall.

faq.q: Why does a priest need a metallurgy book?
faq.answer: Brother Kristoff is preparing a sermon titled "Fortitude of the Spirit." He plans to compare iron's stress during forging with the way trials strengthen the human spirit.

faq.q: Does Milton Sheaf have the book ready right away?
faq.answer: Milton Sheaf says the library holds books on metalworking, but he needs to check for the exact title and arrange a search for Kristoff's book.

angles.text: As a priest, you can see Stormwind's clergy draw on everyday crafts alongside devotion to the Light when teaching spiritual fortitude.
As a blacksmith, you know the forge's hardships. Brother Kristoff plans to use "The Stresses of Iron" to explain endurance under pressure.
As an Alliance member, you can see Cathedral Square's priesthood connected to Stormwind Keep's Royal Library, part of the capital's civic and scholarly life.
